description.text: Grants [Attach Holy with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Lightning (Holy)], [Apex Elegant Drive Damage Tracker] and [Apex Elegant Drive Level]

description.name: Attach Holy with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Holy Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Holy 3

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Lightning (Holy)
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Apex Elegant Drive (0~2), removed after using Apex Elegant Drive two times

description.name: Apex Elegant Drive Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Apex Elegant Drive level by 1 after dealing 100001 or 300001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Lightning (Holy)]

description.name: Apex Elegant Drive Level
description.text: Keeps track of Apex Elegant Drive level (0~2), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Lightning (Holy)]
